text:
Marta Vega: Quick thread — HarborBridge wants a 3-week POC to validate a migration from HaloAPI to Redwood. Main asks: prompt parity, response shape differences (they rely on halo:entities field), KMS/keys, and an initial cost delta. Who can own?
Connor Yates: SE can run a response-diff harness and a small corpus (40 prompts) covering summarization, tone transfer, and troubleshooting. Need sample Halo responses + whether they use session ids for state.
Rhea Kapoor: Ops: we can provision a short-lived dedicated devpool and static egress. Need their CIDR and peering window. BYOK for KMS is supported in Private; for hosted POC we can do envelope with their key.
Owen Li: Pricing: Halo rounds to 50-token increments which biases short replies. For the POC we should model both exact-token billing and Halo-rounded to show customers the delta. Drop expected tokens/month?
Sasha Bell: Security checklist: they want 12mo logs, KMS BYOK, and an on-demand pen-test report. I'll share SOC2 summary and DPA template. NDA signed?
Marta Vega: NDA signed today. Sample prompt set they provided: 1) "Summarize and extract intent/entities" 2) "Rewrite to formal tone" 3) "Provide a 4-step troubleshooting checklist"
Connor Yates: Note: HaloAPI returns entities as an array under "entities" and sometimes attaches metadata.key. We'll normalize shapes in the harness and flag any missing fields. I'll post an initial diff by Thu EOD.
Rhea Kapoor: infra-bot: provisioning request received: harborbridge-poc -> devpool-07. ETA ~30h after CIDR.
Owen Li: Rough POC cost estimate after credits: $950 for 3 weeks assuming 400k tokens and a devpool. I'll add alternative scenarios in the pricing sheet.
Sasha Bell: Sent security packet to their secops. Waiting confirmation on BYOK handshake steps.
Marta Vega: Great. Next steps: SE runs harness + diff, Ops finish peering, Security confirm BYOK steps, Finance populate pricing scenarios. Mid-POC check-in scheduled Mon 09:00 PT. :calendar:
